onboarding.profileIntro: Let's start with a few basics. Theme and language change right away so you can see how they look.
onboarding.activitiesIntro: Add the activities you want to log time for, e.g. running or strength. You can always add more later.
onboarding.goalsIntro: How much do you want to train? Set a total goal across all activities or one per activity. You can also do this later.
onboarding.summaryIntro: Here are your choices. Save to get started, or go back and change something.

landing.headline: Train more. Log less.
landing.lead: Install Treni on your phone or computer and keep it close at hand – it launches from your home screen, works offline and needs no app store.
landing.continueInBrowser: Use it in the browser instead

log.title: Log in seconds
log.text: Spin in the time and date with your thumb – done in a couple of taps.

goals.title: Hit your goals
goals.text: Set weekly and monthly goals and watch the rings fill as you train.

offline.title: Always with you
offline.text: Sits on your home screen like any other app and works without a connection.

landing.installedText: Open Treni from your home screen or app menu for the best experience.
landing.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari (the square with an arrow pointing up)
landing.iosStep3: Tap “Add” – Treni shows up among your apps
landing.manualStep2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”
landing.manualStep3: Confirm – Treni shows up among your apps
